name: Jiangsu Zhongtian Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Zhongtian Technology Co., Ltd. produces and sells electrical machinery and equipment for the communications, electric power, marine, new energy, marine engineering construction, and other business sectors in China and internationally. It provides telecommunication products, including PON, optical fiber cables, Fttx, coaxial cables, antennas, telecom power systems, optical transceivers, and micro modular data center products; and submarine cables comprising medium voltage, HVAC, and HVDC submarine cables, as well as EPIC, submarine fiber optic cables, and accessories.
